meta.title: Mecatol Online base data: full TI4 base game + Codices
meta.scope: Twilight Imperium 4th edition BASE GAME + Codices I-IV, all 17 factions, 2-6 players. Content per content_sets.json (base first, Codex errata noted).
meta.text_convention: Fields named text / primary / secondary are verbatim card or faction-sheet text (capitalised keywords as printed). Stat lines follow the printed order Cost, Combat, Move, Capacity.
meta.cross_check: Every faction/unit/tech/strategy-card value was compared between the AsyncTI4 bot data files and the Twilight Imperium fandom wiki; where they differ the difference is noted in a 'notes' field. Promissory-note base texts were additionally confirmed against BoardGameGeek and the tirules reference; strategy-card colours were sampled from the official card scans hosted by ti4ultimate.com; errata wording was taken from the FFG Living Rules Reference v1.3 PDF.

abilities.name: ASSIMILATE
abilities.text: When you gain control of a planet, replace each PDS and space dock that is on that planet with a matching unit from your reinforcements.

abilities.name: HARROW
abilities.text: After each round of ground combat, your ships in the active system may use their BOMBARDMENT abilities against your opponent's ground forces on the planet.
abilities.notes: 'text' is the wording printed on the base-game faction sheet (verified against the official faction-sheet scan hosted by ti4ultimate.com): it begins 'After each round of ground combat'. The FFG Living Rules Reference errata (introduced in LRR v1.2, 06/12/19; retained in v1.3, 05/04/20) replaces it with the 'text_errata_lrr' wording: 'The text of the L1Z1X's "Harrow" faction ability should read as follows: "At the end of each round of ground combat, your ships in the active system may use their bombardment abilities against your opponent's ground forces on the planet."' (LRR prints the keyword in lower case.) Recommend implementing the errata wording. LRR 56.2: 'The "Planetary Shield" ability prevents an L1Z1X player from using their "Harrow" faction ability.' LRR 15.1 bullet: 'The L1Z1X's "Harrow" ability does not affect the L1Z1X player's own ground forces.'
abilities.text_errata_lrr: At the end of each round of ground combat, your ships in the active system may use their BOMBARDMENT abilities against your opponent's ground forces on the planet.

promissory_note.name: Cybernetic Enhancements
promissory_note.text_base_game:
At the start of your turn:
Remove 1 token from the L1Z1X player's strategy pool and return it to his reinforcements. Then, place 1 command token from your reinforcements in your strategy pool.
Then, return this card to the L1Z1X player.
promissory_note.text_codex1_omega:
When you gain command tokens during the status phase:
Gain 1 additional command token.
Then, return this card to the L1Z1X player.
promissory_note.notes: Base text verified against the official base-game card scan (ti4ultimate.com CyberneticEnhancements.webp): the 2017 printing uses 'his reinforcements'. Also confirmed by fandom (faction page + Promissory Notes page) and BoardGameGeek thread 1854869. The omega (Ω) version was released in Codex I (Ordinian, 2020) as an official replacement (verified against the Codex I PDF, page 9); AsyncTI4 ships only the omega text. tirules ruling: if the L1Z1X player has no command tokens in their strategy pool, the base version cannot be played.

abilities.name: MUNITIONS RESERVES
abilities.text: At the start of each round of space combat, you may spend 2 trade goods; you may reroll any number of your dice during that combat round.
abilities.notes: Verbatim from the official faction-sheet scan (ti4ultimate.com): the sheet prints 'reroll' (unhyphenated); fandom writes 're-roll'. AsyncTI4 paraphrases: 'You may spend 2 trade goods to re-roll any number of your dice during that combat round.' Ruling (tirules): may only be triggered once per combat round; cannot spend 4 TG for two rerolls.

abilities.name: ARMADA
abilities.text: The maximum number of non-fighter ships you can have in each system is equal to 2 more than the number of tokens in your fleet pool.

faction_technologies.name: L4 Disruptors

faction_technologies.name: Non-Euclidean Shielding

flagship.name: Arc Secundus
flagship.text:
Other players' units in this system lose PLANETARY SHIELD.

promissory_note.name: War Funding
promissory_note.text_base_game:
At the start of a round of space combat:
The Letnev player loses 2 trade goods.
During this combat round, reroll any number of your dice.
Then, return this card to the Letnev player.
promissory_note.text_codex1_omega:
After you and your opponent roll dice during space combat:
You may reroll all of your opponent's dice.
You may reroll any number of your dice.
Then, return this card to the Letnev player.
promissory_note.notes: Base text verified against the official base-game card scan (ti4ultimate.com War Funding.webp): three separate paragraphs, 'reroll' unhyphenated. Fandom writes 're-roll'. The omega (Ω) version was released in Codex I (Ordinian, 2020) as an official replacement (verified against the Codex I PDF, page 9); AsyncTI4 ships only the omega text. Ruling (tirules): base War Funding may be played even if the Letnev player has 0 or 1 trade goods; the omega version only rerolls combat rolls, not anti-fighter barrage.

units.notes: Shared base-game unit table. 'produced_per_cost' = number of units you get for paying the cost once (fighters and infantry come in pairs: 'Cost 1 (x2)'). Combat value = hit on that number or higher on a d10. Structures (PDS, Space Dock) have no cost, combat, move or capacity; they are placed via the Construction strategy card. Unit-upgrade technologies are of the type 'unit upgrade' (no colour); their prerequisites are given as colour counts.

II.name: Infantry II
II.text: After this unit is destroyed, roll 1 die. If the result is 6 or greater, place the unit on this card. At the start of your next turn, place each unit that is on this card on a planet you control in your home system.
II.notes: Wording 'At the start of your next turn' confirmed by the official Learn to Play booklet text (2017 and 2020 printings, page 16 text layer), fandom and AsyncTI4 technology data. The AsyncTI4 hover image for Infantry II (a fan-rendered card) reads 'At the start of your turn' and is treated as the outlier.

strategy_cards.notes: All eight base-game cards listed; the six used in the duel are flagged with used_in_duel=true (Politics and Construction are dropped). 'primary'/'secondary' are the printed base-game (2017) texts. 'errata' gives the FFG Living Rules Reference / Codex I replacement text where one exists. Colours: 'colour_name' is the conventional name, 'colour_hex_async' is the AsyncTI4 colourHexCode, 'colour_hex_sampled' is the dominant saturated colour sampled from the official card scan on ti4ultimate.com (both agree).

cards.name: Leadership
primary: Spend any amount of influence to gain 1 command token for every 3 influence spent.
secondary: Spend any amount of influence to gain 1 command token for every 3 influence spent.
cards.notes: Secondary does not cost a strategy token.

cards.name: Diplomacy
primary: Choose 1 system other than the Mecatol Rex system that contains a planet you control; each other player places a command token from his reinforcements in the chosen system. Then, ready each exhausted planet you control in that system.
secondary: Spend 1 token from your strategy pool to ready up to 2 exhausted planets.

errata.source: FFG Living Rules Reference v1.3 (errata section); reprinted as Diplomacy Ω card in Codex I and in Prophecy of Kings
primary: Choose 1 system other than the Mecatol Rex system that contains a planet you control; each other player places a command token from their reinforcements in that system. Then, ready up to 2 exhausted planets you control.
secondary: Spend 1 token from your strategy pool to ready up to 2 exhausted planets you control.

cards.notes: Printed base text verified against the official card scan (ti4ultimate.com Diplomacy.webp) and the Learn to Play booklet's strategy-card overview (2017 and 2020 printings): the 2017 card reads 'from his reinforcements' (fandom and AsyncTI4 obsolete.json base2 modernise this to 'their'). The Diplomacy errata first appears in LRR v1.1 (02/03/18) and is listed again in LRR v1.3 (05/04/20); the errata text quoted here is from v1.3 and matches the Codex I Diplomacy Ω card scan (ti4ultimate.com DiplomacyCodexOrdinian.webp). Recommend implementing the errata text. LRR 30.2: if a player has no command tokens in reinforcements they place one of their choice from their command sheet; a player who already has a token in the chosen system does not place another.

cards.name: Politics
primary: Choose a player other than the speaker. That player gains the speaker token.
Look at the top 2 cards of the agenda deck. Place each card on the top or bottom of the deck in any order.
secondary: Spend 1 token from your strategy pool to draw 2 action cards.

cards.name: Construction
primary: Place 1 PDS or 1 space dock on a planet you control.
Place 1 PDS on a planet you control.
secondary: Place 1 token from your strategy pool in any system; you may place either 1 space dock or 1 PDS on a planet you control in that system.
cards.notes: Base-game printed text verified against the official card scan (ti4ultimate.com Construction.webp): 'space dock' is lower case on the card (AsyncTI4 capitalises it). PoK reworded the secondary to 'Spend 1 token from your strategy pool and place it in any system; you may place either 1 space dock or 1 PDS on a planet you control in that system' with identical effect. Not used in the duel.

cards.name: Trade
primary: Choose any number of other players. Those players use the secondary ability of this strategy card without spending a command token.
secondary: Spend 1 token from your strategy pool to replenish commodities.
cards.notes: Printed card (ti4ultimate.com Trade.webp scan, and the Learn to Play strategy-card overview) reads 'replenish commodities.' with no 'your'; AsyncTI4's 'replenish your commodities' is a paraphrase. Fandom wording matches the card.

cards.name: Warfare
primary: Remove 1 of your command tokens from the game board; then, gain 1 command token.
Redistribute any number of the command tokens on your command sheet.
secondary: Spend 1 token from your strategy pool to use the PRODUCTION ability of 1 of your space docks in your home system.
cards.notes: Printed card verified against the official scan (ti4ultimate.com Warfare.webp): the secondary ends at 'in your home system.' with no parenthetical. AsyncTI4 appends '(this token is not placed in your home system)' as a reminder; fandom lists it as a rules note. Rule: the spent token goes to reinforcements, not the home system.

cards.name: Technology
secondary: Spend 1 token from your strategy pool and 4 resources to research 1 technology.

cards.name: Imperial
primary: Immediately score 1 public objective if you fulfill its requirements.
Gain 1 victory point if you control Mecatol Rex; otherwise, draw 1 secret objective.
secondary: Spend 1 token from your strategy pool to draw 1 secret objective.
